Page Cache: Only PHP-side events are counted. Static file, reverse proxy and CDN hits do not run PHP and are not included.
页面缓存: 仅统计 PHP 侧事件。静态文件、反向代理和 CDN 命中不运行 PHP，不计入统计。

Page Cache: Full records every request event. Sampled records a percentage of requests. Purge, flush and warmup events are always recorded.
页面缓存: 完整模式记录每个请求事件。采样模式按比例记录请求。Purge、Flush 和 Warmup 事件始终完整记录。

Page Cache: Fraction from 0 to 1. For example 0.05 records about 5% of request events when mode is Sampled.
页面缓存: 0 到 1 之间的小数。例如 0.05 在采样模式下记录约 5% 的请求事件。

Page Cache: Statistics are sampled at %s. Counts are estimates, not exact totals. Purge, flush and warmup events are recorded completely.
页面缓存: 统计按 %s 采样。计数为估算值，不是精确总量。Purge、Flush 和 Warmup 事件仍完整记录。

Page Cache: Store gzip HTML when it is smaller than plain. The HTML size limit is in General.
页面缓存: 压缩后更小时保存 gzip HTML。HTML 大小上限在“常规”组。

Page Cache: Pages smaller than this stay plain. Default is 4096.
页面缓存: 小于该值的页面不压缩。默认 4096。

Page Cache: gzip level from 1 to 9. Default is 6.
One origin per line, for example https://www.example.com. The scheme, host and port must match exactly. Use this for store alias domains that warmup may request.
页面缓存: 每行一个 origin，例如 https://www.example.com。scheme、host 和 port 必须完全匹配。用于预热需要访问的 store 别名域名。

Page Cache: How many times a purge hand-off is tried before the row is marked failed.
页面缓存: purge 投递失败后最多尝试多少次，超过后标记为 failed。

Page Cache: Base delay for exponential backoff. The delay doubles after each failed attempt.
页面缓存: 指数退避的基础秒数。每次失败后间隔翻倍。

Page Cache: Log a warning when the oldest pending purge is older than this. Default is 3600.
页面缓存: 最老的 pending purge 超过该秒数时记录 warning。默认 3600。

Page Cache: How long delivered and failed outbox rows are kept for status. Default is 7.
页面缓存: delivered 和 failed 行保留多少天用于状态查询。默认 7。

Page Cache: A claimed row returns to pending when its lease expires. Default is 300.
页面缓存: 已领取的行在租约过期后回到 pending。默认 300。

Page Cache: Record tag and full invalidations in the page cache audit table. Independent from request statistics.
页面缓存: 把 tag 和全量失效记录到页面缓存审计表。独立于请求统计。

Page Cache: How long invalidation records are kept. Default is 30.
页面缓存: 失效记录保留多少天。默认 30。

Page Cache: Maximum number of tag names stored per record. The total count is always stored. Default is 20.
页面缓存: 每条记录最多保存多少个 tag 名。总数始终保存。默认 20。

Page Cache: Invalidation audit is disabled. Enable it under System > Configuration > Page Cache > Invalidation Audit.
页面缓存: 失效审计已关闭。在 System > Configuration > Page Cache > Invalidation Audit 中开启。
